scope: Bound Best Buy country-workflow document/link discovery and native navigation, preserve caller cancellation and confirmed-closure fallback, and forward precise failure phases through API queues. A selected four-target proxy-free cohort is separate from the earlier full-100 result.

diagnosis.observedPriorFailure: Best Buy received HTTP 200, exhausted the workflow deadline and skipped an alternate for insufficient remaining budget.
diagnosis.confirmedCodeDefect: The nominal five-second loop window did not bound either awaited discovery RPC. Both used the entire caller deadline; subsequent country navigation also received all remaining time.

before.limit: Dependency-level reproduction on the real compiled workflow, not an actual renderer hang or measured native-navigation latency.

after.limit: Dependency-level reproduction on the real compiled workflow, not an actual renderer hang or measured native-navigation latency.

beforeAfterReproduction.limit: Blocked discovery dependencies on the actual compiled workflow, with Docker networking disabled. The navigation observation is a passed native timeout parameter, not a measured browser timeout. Actual native navigation and closure are tested separately through the queued API.

implementation.failureBehavior: A stalled discovery query or timed-out navigation fails the current browser attempt. It is not promoted to ready content. Existing opted-in distinct-engine fallback still requires matching ownership, confirmed Page closure and sufficient shared time.
implementation.lateResultGuard: Both discovery awaits race the same local window and the caller deadline. Check budgets before/after each result; a late result cannot continue to link discovery or dispatch navigation. Await native navigation under its own timeout rather than an additional short timer.
implementation.phaseForwarding: Only these fixed phase strings are added to the existing bounded document-receipt allowlist. URL redaction and queue serialization remain in effect.
implementation.destinationGuard: Keep the existing candidate-origin, product-path and SKU check. No country-control forcing, verification automation, support submission or default retry is added.
implementation.navigationControlLimit: browserControls.navigationTimeout remains the initial-navigation cap. The thirty-second country-navigation maximum is a separate recipe bound.

pacing.limit: Slot reservation precedes fetch. Observed gaps are retained; configuration is not an exact dispatch floor.

fullApiCohort.comparisonLimit: Four-target selected cohort after bounding country discovery/navigation and forwarding precise timeout phases, not a full 100-target result, paired old-code test or hosted comparison. No population coverage or standalone primary-only score is inferred.

bestBuyEpochComparison.explanation: The current primary failed in initial navigation under the existing cap, before the country workflow ran. Firefox then completed country navigation and matched HTML/Markdown. The new workflow bounds were not the cause of that primary failure or the observed recovery. The previous workflow timeout and current recovery are different live epochs.

lastFull100TargetMeasurement.limit: Predates the optional-product-details and country-budget repairs. Selected observations are not added to that aggregate.

limits: A fresh complete 100-target measurement on this candidate is still required. The last complete score remains 61/100 on earlier code; the historical hosted82 reference was not refreshed.
The selected result is 3/4. Best Buy matched through an existing initial-navigation timeout followed by Firefox recovery; no isolated new-workflow-cap effect on live success or latency is inferred.
Canada Goose still misses its frozen marker even though a document is returned. Markdown can contain hidden HTML; formatting or usedSecondary alone is not proof of visible expected content.
A validated country destination is a request-URL check. Server redirects and marker matches do not establish field-level identity or extraction completeness.

The new recipe bounds can fail a slow but otherwise valid selector/navigation earlier than the overall request deadline. Other phases still share the caller deadline; alternate budget is not universally guaranteed.

research.use: Use the native navigation timeout and await its completion before cleanup; keep closure proof separate from a timeout classification.
An awaited document/link query needs a workflow deadline as well as the outer caller deadline; an expired read must not authorize later navigation.
